title: Vibecode key
description: Use your Bitrix24 Vibecode key for the AI review of the function, without spending credits.
adminOnly: Only portal administrators can configure the Vibecode key.
configuredVerified: Key configured, ending in {last4}, tested on {date}.
notConfigured: No key saved. The AI review uses the app credits.
notConfiguredUnavailable: No key saved. The AI review uses the app credits and is currently unavailable without your own key.

hints.scope: Create the key with the vibe:ai scope only: it does not need access to portal data.
hints.sent: The function and knowledge base text is sent to Vibecode during the AI review.
hints.stored: The key is stored encrypted and is not shown again once saved.

removed: Key removed. The AI review will use credits again.

errors.AI_KEY_REQUIRED: To review with AI, provide the Vibecode key.
errors.AI_KEY_INVALID: Vibecode did not accept the key. Check that it was copied in full and is still active.
errors.AI_KEY_SCOPE: The key must have the vibe:ai scope.
errors.AI_NO_BALANCE: The Vibecode account has run out of balance or quota.
errors.AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The key does not have access to the model used in the review, or the model is down.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI review is down right now. Try again in a moment.
